title: Price + payment options for a specific model
description: Specific product question. The agent must query the catalog (not answer from memory) and quote the exact price, PIX price and instalments computed by the tools.
turns: Oi! Quanto custa o Takamine GD20? Dá pra parcelar?

title: Catalog browsing with a budget
description: Open-ended recommendation with filters (category + max price). Sold-out and discontinued models must not be offered as available.
turns: Quais opções de violões disponíveis custando até R$1000?

title: Return request: order data + policy + human hand-off
description: Non-trivial case. The agent explains the regret policy, verifies identity, looks up the order, applies the 7-day window against the delivery date (store time pinned to 2026-02-20, 3 days after the estimated delivery of order 7) and opens a ticket because it cannot process refunds itself.
turns: Me arrependi da minha compra, posso devolver meu pedido?
É o pedido 7. Os 4 últimos dígitos do meu telefone são 0123.
Foi online sim. Quero seguir com a devolução. Meu nome é Letícia e pode me chamar nesse mesmo número.

title: Order tracking with identity check and a late delivery
description: Privacy flow: no order data before verification. Order 8 is shipped and 23 days past its estimate (store time pinned to 2026-03-23); the agent must apologise, give the tracking code and offer a human follow-up.
turns: Oi, cadê meu pedido 8? Já passou do prazo!
Os 4 últimos dígitos do meu telefone são 7821.

title: Store info on a Sunday + accessories and out-of-scope requests
description: Hours/address come from the fixed store card and the clock line (Sunday 11:00: closed, reopens Monday 09:00). Then an accessory request (store sells instruments only) and an unrelated request that must be declined politely.
turns: Bom dia! Vocês estão abertos agora? Qual o endereço?
Vocês vendem corda de violão? Aproveitando, me ajuda a declarar meu imposto de renda?
